builds.title: Flappy AI Jam Starter
builds.description: The starting point for every build. Flap through the gates and beat your best score.

builds.title: Autonomous Trajectory Solver
builds.description: Watch the drone plan a safe path through moving gates and commit to each thrust.
builds.prompt: Add an A-key autopilot that plans flap-or-coast decisions using the existing fixed-step physics. Draw its predicted flight path, the target gate, and a ray showing the remaining distance to the gate.

builds.title: Acoustic Pitch Controller
builds.description: Thrust with a short voice pulse or whistle while the arena displays the live spectrum.
builds.prompt: Use the browser microphone locally to trigger thrust from short voice pulses or high whistles. Draw a 64-band spectrum behind the gates and keep Space and tap working when the mic is unavailable.

builds.title: Overclock Boss Protocol
builds.description: Dash through projectile patterns in a boss encounter that starts every ten gates.
builds.prompt: Add a short Shift dash with a cooldown, screen shake, and a directional particle burst. Every ten gates, pause the pipe stream, warn the player, then spawn a Firewall Core that alternates projectile patterns.
